name: hud_geom2d_classify_point_against_segment
description: HudGeom2D::ClassifyPointAgainstSegment classifies a point against a directed finite 2D segment for line-clip straddle tests.
known_limits: Tier C only; no VC COFF byte-comparison target exists yet, so tier S remains open.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly/decompilation at 0x416390 has no direct callees and returns +1 for positive cross product, -1 for negative cross product, -1 for collinear points before segment start, +1 for collinear points beyond segment end, and 0 only for collinear points on the segment; HLIL has expected x87 flag-word verbosity.
The native rect-clip helper smoke verifies positive, negative, on-segment, before-segment, and after-segment classifications.
vc5_attempt: python tools/recoil.py verify vc5 --explain-missing 0x416390 reported no VC verification target currently covers this address.
